custom_css: .web-form-container { max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto; } .web-form-introduction { background: #f8f9fa; border-left: 4px solid #2490ef; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 4px; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; } .web-form-introduction h3 { color: #1f272e; margin-top: 0; } .library-availability-ok { color: #1c9e3f; } .library-availability-bad { color: #c0392b; } .web-form .frappe-control[data-fieldname="library_book"] .help, .web-form .frappe-control[data-fieldname="member"] .help { font-style: italic; }
introduction_text:
Borrow a Book

Welcome to Frappe Library. Use this form to request a book. Please read the instructions before submitting:

  1. Your member record is filled in automatically from your login. Please verify it.
  2. Choose a book. Out-of-stock or unpublished books cannot be requested and will be rejected.
  3. Pick the date you want to borrow the book and the date you will return it (due date). The due date cannot be earlier than the borrow date.
  4. Click Submit Borrow Request. A librarian will process your request shortly.
name: library-borrow-request
success_message: Thank you! Your borrow request has been submitted successfully. A librarian will review it shortly and you will be notified once your book is issued.
